test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**In the given sentence, identify the segment which contains a grammatical error.**

You should have reports the matter to your teacher instead of taking it in your own hands.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **reports the matter**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace** "reports" **with **"reported" **to correct the sentence.
 
• The verb "**Report**" means to give people information about what you have seen, heard, done, etc.
 
 
• We use the verb "**report**" with the first person singular or plural subject and the second person singular or plural subject. (I/you/we)
 
• We use the verb "**reports**" only with a third-person singular subject. (He/She)
 
• In this given sentence "**you**" is mentioned and we know that it refers to the second-person singular or second-person plural. So, "**reports**" should not be used.
 
 
 
• "**have + verb(3rd)**" is used to form the present perfect tense and "**have" is always followed by the 3rd form of the verb.**
 
• The present perfect tense uses "**have + verb + ed**" to describe something that occurred in the past and have either present consequences or is still occurring.
 
• We use "**should have + past participle**" to talk about things we regret or should not be done.
 
• Therefore, "**reported**" should be used instead of "**reports**"

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**, which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence:** *You should have **reported __**the matter to your teacher instead of taking it in your own hands.*
